rationale: The discourse has stabilized around a procedural consensus on testing a no-closure package, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still insist on no closures/no compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still require closure-level economics and retain closure as a fallback. The last two rounds mainly restated these positions with only process-level movement, so further repetition is unlikely to change the outcome without an external intervention or hard fact-finding mandate.
